name: typescript
description: This an example of using esptool-js with parcel and typescript

scripts.dev: npm-run-all clean copyBuild copyStatic genDocs parcel:dev
scripts.copyBuild: shx mkdir -p src/build && shx cp -r ../../../build/* src/build/ || echo 'Build directory not found'
scripts.copyStatic: shx mkdir -p static && shx cp -r src/build/* static/
scripts.genDocs: npm run genDocs:root && shx mkdir -p dist && shx cp -r ../../docs dist
